comment: Screen sizes the preview harnesses offer, in CSS pixels, which is what
the app's own media queries and layout actually respond to.
One list, read by both harnesses: the test site at /field-preview and
the single file preview built by apps/field-app. They must not disagree
about what the app looks like, and two copies of this list is exactly
Real sizes, not round numbers. The point of checking a layout at 360px
is that a rep somewhere is holding a phone that is exactly 360px. Note
that the narrowest phone here is a Samsung, not an iPhone: Android is
the tighter constraint, which is easy to get wrong by testing on an
iPhone and assuming the rest follows.
shell picks the frame drawn around it. Android phones are squarer than
iPhones and it is worth being able to see which one you are looking at.
